source_text: Περὶ δὲ τοῦ βαπτίσματος, οὕτω βαπτίσατε: ταῦτα πάντα προειπόντες, βαπτίσατε εἰς τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ πατρὸς καὶ τοῦ υἱοῦ καὶ τοῦ ἁγίου πνεύματος ἐν ὕδατι ζῶντι. ἐὰν δὲ μὴ ἔχῃς ὕδωρ ζῶν, εἰς ἄλλο ὕδωρ βάπτισον: εἰ δ’ οὐ δύνασαι ἐν ψυχρῷ, ἐν θερμῷ. ἐὰν δὲ ἀμφότερα μὴ ἔχῃς, ἔκχεον εἰς τὴν κεφαλὴν τρὶς ὕδωρ εἰς ὄνομα πατρὸς καὶ υἱοῦ καὶ ἁγίου πνεύματος. πρὸ δὲ τοῦ βαπτίσματος προνηστευσάτω ὁ βαπτίζων καὶ ὁ βαπτιζόμενος καὶ εἴ τινες ἄλλοι δύνανται: κελεύεις δὲ νηστεῦσαι τὸν βαπτιζόμενον πρὸ μιᾶς ἢ δύο.
pass_a_gloss: Concerning the baptism, baptize thus: having said all these things, baptize into the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit in living water. If you do not have living water, baptize in other water; if you are not able in cold, in warm. If you do not have both, pour water on the head three times into the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit. Before the baptism, let the one baptizing and the one being baptized fast, and if any others are able; you command the one being baptized to fast one or two days.
pass_b_english: Concerning baptism, baptize in this way: after you have said all these things, baptize into the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit using living water. If you do not have living water, use other water; if you cannot baptize in cold water, use warm water. If you have neither, pour water on the head three times into the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit. Before the baptism, let the one who baptizes and the one who is baptized fast, and anyone else who is able; you must command the one being baptized to fast for one or two days.

anf_compare.notes: Drafted from source only; ANF not shown to drafter.

review.notes: The translation accurately reflects the Greek text of Didache 7. Pass A and Pass B are consistent with the source. Pass B's slight expansion of 'cold' to 'cold water' and 'warm' to 'warm water' is a permissible stylistic choice that does not alter the meaning or agency.
